title: Agent session certificate
description: Issued by the team services when they start or move an agent: this agent, of this type and team role, runs on this host from started_at until ends_at. The team services renew a running session before ends_at and rewrite it with the actual end when the agent stops or moves. A frame that names an agent must fall inside one of its sessions on the signing host.

placement_revision.description: The placement record's revision when the session started; a newer session of the same agent has a higher one.
